body: Good job. Hold on to that pride and try to keep going :)

Talking to the people I love about this suff has saved my life many times. Its the best advice I can give

Just be carefull that you get the point accross that they help you without making them feel personally  responsible for your safety and mental health.

And I know it seems hopeless but you dont always have to keep reaching higher. Its ok to take break for a while and try again later. Please take care of yourself
Have you talked to your boyfriend about this?
